# Road to Recommendation (R2R) — LLM Knowledge Base & Site Guide

> R2R is an elite, anti-factory SSB (Services Selection Board) mentorship studio founded by twice and thrice recommended mentors. We prepare defense aspirants for NDA, CDS, AFCAT, TES, and JAG entries by diagnosing and resolving authentic psychological, personal interview, and screening gaps.

## Primary Mentors (EEAT Authority)
- **Shashank Rai**: Founder & Lead SSB Mentor. AIR-19 CDS-1 2018, twice recommended for the Indian Army. Specializes in line-by-line Psychological Testing deconstruction (TAT, WAT, SRT) and Personal Interview strategy.
- **Neha Vashisth**: Psychology & Screening Specialist. Thrice recommended SSB mentor, Masters in Health Administration (TISS Mumbai). Specializes in Subconscious Narrative Analysis, PPDT / screening narration, and natural emotional projection.
- **Rahul Sharma**: Personal Interview Specialist. JAG-35 AIR 9, practicing advocate at the Armed Forces Tribunal. Specializes in PIQ cross-examination, rapid-fire stress handling, and career-gap justification.

## Core Differentiators
- **Strict Cap**: 15 candidates per cohort maximum (compared to 100-250 candidate lecture-hall batches in traditional coaching institutes).
- **Zero Rote Scripts**: Rejects memorized officer-like-qualities (OLQ) tropes, artificial TAT story templates, and coached moralistic answers that lead to screening and conference rejections.
- **Line-by-Line Dossier Analysis**: Mentors personally evaluate all 12 TAT stories, 60 WAT associations, and detailed PIQ responses.

## Programs & Pricing
- **15-Day Online Studio**: Available on official store at https://r2rssb.graphy.com/s/store (~₹12,000 INR for full course; modular batches available). Full 1-on-1 dossier analysis, live psychological testing sessions, mock interviews, and personal feedback over video.
- **15-Day Delhi Offline Studio**: ₹18,000 INR tuition fee (Budget student PGs in walking distance in Patel Nagar). Includes in-person boardroom mock interviews, screening drills, and physical group task dynamics. Strictly capped at 15 candidates.
